typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExtactFilePath as string (),
	ExtractToFile as string (),
	LO_REPORT_INFO as string (),
	LSQ_ARCH as string (),
	LSQ_DELETE as string (),
	LSQ_GETREPORT_DETAILS as string (),
	LS_FILE as string (),
	OLL_BATCHID as integer (),
	OLL_REPTID as integer (),
	OLL_SCHDID as integer (),
	OLS_ARCH as string (),
	OLS_OUTA as string (),
	OLS_OUTP as string (),
	OLS_Query1 as string (),
	OLS_Query2 as string (),
	OracleDataSource as string (),
	OraclePassword as string (),
	OracleProvider as string (),
	OracleUserID as string (),
	PDT_BATDATE as timestamp (),
	PDT_RUNDATE as timestamp (),
	PL_BATID as integer (),
	PL_REPTID as integer (),
	PL_SCHID as integer (),
	RLL_RecordCount as integer (),
	RunDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		EXRT_INFO as string,
		EXRT_DET1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select EXRT_INFO, EXRT_DET1  from AGP.MSB_REPORT_EXTRACT where 1=2',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(EXRT_INFO = EXRT_INFO) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount1
PlaceHolderRowCount1 derive(DR_BATCHID = OLL_BATCHID,
		DR_REPTID = OLL_REPTID,
		DR_SCHD_ID = OLL_SCHDID,
		DR_DTL2 = toString(' ')) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn split(ExtractToFile == 'Y', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(File,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit1@File sink(input(
		Schedule_ID as integer,
		DTL1 as string,
		DTL2 as string,
		BATCH_ID as integer,
		INFO as string,
		REPORT_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Schedule_ID = DR_SCHD_ID,
		DTL1 = EXRT_DET1,
		DTL2 = DR_DTL2,
		BATCH_ID = DR_BATCHID,
		INFO = EXRT_INFO,
		REPORT_ID = DR_REPTID)) ~> Extract
ConditionalSplit1@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput sink(input(
		EXRT_DET1 as string,
		EXRT_DET2 as string,
		EXRT_INFO as string,
		BATCH_ID as integer,
		SCHD_ID as integer,
		REPT_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		EXRT_DET1,
		EXRT_DET2 = DR_DTL2,
		EXRT_INFO,
		BATCH_ID = DR_BATCHID,
		SCHD_ID = DR_SCHD_ID,
		REPT_ID = DR_REPTID)) ~> OLEDBDestination
